content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Default
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is hereby notified that it has failed to comply with the terms of the Lease Agreement, specifically the requirement to pay rent in full by the first day of each month.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Notice_Period
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is given thirty (30) days from the date of this Notice to cure the default by paying the overdue rent in full, together with any late fees, to avoid the commencement of eviction proceedings.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant fails to cure the default within the thirty (30) day period, the Landlord reserves the right to commence legal action to recover possession of the premises and collect any damages incurred as a result of the Tenant's failure to comply with the terms of the Lease Agreement.
